# BCGov Crow - v0.11.3

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow adds security-control assurance checks that tests
cited as evidence actually exercise production controls rather than
reproducing their behavior inside the test.

## Highlights

- Security-control assurance traces a cited test's actions and assertions to
  its production enforcement point, including calls made through helpers,
  mocks, and callbacks.
- Tests that perform a cleanup or authorization sequence themselves no longer
  count as evidence that the production control works.

## Changes

- Security-relevant data retention, deletion, and credential revocation are
  explicit control-assurance review targets.
- Reviewers consider other valid tests before reporting a coverage gap and
  hand replacement-test requirements to the testing workflow.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed - 0 errors, 0 warnings.

- Archive inspection: Passed - 206 entries, including the

- Additional checks: Security review synthesis and release draft tests passed;

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.11.3 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.11.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
